about: Code that names a local picture and can't carry its version (name.<hash>.ext, tools/lib/image-version.mjs): a script's string or a stylesheet's url() is not a page, so tools/version-images.mjs leaves it, and the picture is cached the ten minutes every unversioned address gets (.htaccess). One entry per file, or per folder when the path ends in a slash, with its owner and why. check-site fails on code that names a local picture without its version and is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer names one, so this list only shrinks. A fix: have the page that loads the script or stylesheet write the versioned address (or, for a built bundle, its build), then remove the entry.

gaps.why: the sign-up form script writes its three product icons' addresses at run time
stylesheet url(): the cursor pictures and the Speedometer card's background
the ranking script writes the store badge's address at run time
VHub's Vite bundles, built with hashed names and published by the Deployer: pictures named in their strings
the game's built stylesheets (backdrops, cursors), published by the Deployer's palermo-web run
the party doors' built stylesheets (cursors), published by the Deployer
